summary.text: Dan Troy is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who represents District 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army veteran and engineer, he is ranking member of the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dan Troy was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and served in the U.S. Army from 1970 to 1976.
He received a bachelor's degree from the University of Dayton in 1970.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an air balance technician and project engineer at Kahoe Air Balance Company and Professional Balance Company and teaching state and local government courses at Lakeland Community College.

He has also served with the Northern Ohio Public Energy Council, the Lake County Wisdom Collaborative, the McKinley Center Food Bank, the Applewood Behavioral Centers, and the Chagrin River Watershed Partnership Board.
Troy assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists him as ranking member of the House Ways and Means Committee and a member of the Government Oversight Committee.
In the general election he faces Republican Julie A. Belich.
